request.summary: Create a time-aware event agenda backed by an existing Wallboard calendar integration.
request.audience: Visitors and employees scanning the current and upcoming programme from shared signage.
request.primaryGoal: Feature the active or next event while keeping the rest of the day readable across common signage layouts.

assumptions: The customer already has a Google, Microsoft, or iCalendar datasource configured in Wallboard.
Cancelled and malformed events should be ignored without preventing valid events from rendering.
Bundled calendar names, event details, timestamps, and identifiers are synthetic and preserve only representative provider shapes.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Venue agendas are placed in full-screen, split, portrait, and compact signage zones.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom color scheme.
Message shown when no valid events remain.
Maximum number of upcoming events rendered.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, keep one line and ellipsize the remaining tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The configurable agenda title must remain complete whenever possible without colliding with the date and clock.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, keep one line and ellipsize before the event count.
dynamicText.rationale: The section heading shares a bounded row with a live count and must adapt without moving that count.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after two lines while preserving time, location, and active-event state.
dynamicText.rationale: The featured event can carry a two-line editorial title, but the full agenda must remain visible in the assigned zone.

states.expectation: The coordinated light preset keeps current and upcoming agenda items clearly differentiated.
Nested Microsoft-style timestamps normalize into a chronological Full HD agenda whose title and event descenders remain intact.
iCalendar summary and flat timestamp fields normalize into the same agenda model.
An explicit empty state replaces the agenda body.
Long titles, descriptions, venues, and locations remain contained.
All-day events use an explicit all-day label instead of misleading clock times.
Calendar updates replace visible event data without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Google or Microsoft and iCalendar responses produce the same stable agenda hierarchy.
An event spanning the current time is marked live and reports bounded progress.
A datasource refresh updates the visible programme in place.

visualDirection.summary: A venue programme with an editorial current-event feature and a chronological supporting rail.
signatureChoices: The active or next event occupies the main reading field.
Upcoming events use a continuous timeline rather than repeated cards.
avoid: A generic page counter in the top-right corner.

visualReview.intent: A calm, editorial venue agenda with a strong live-event focal point and a compact chronological timeline.
focus: Verify the featured event and upcoming timeline share the available area without dead zones or clipped copy.
Verify wide-low and portrait layouts preserve hierarchy rather than merely shrinking the desktop composition.
Verify configurable headings and repeated event titles retain visible descenders at Full HD.
